name: OpenRouter Models API
summary: Public catalogue of LLMs routable through OpenRouter, with context lengths, modalities, per-token prices and supported parameters.
description: GET /api/v1/models lists every model OpenRouter can route to, with id, display name, creation date, description, context length, input and output modalities, tokenizer, prompt and completion prices per token, top-provider limits, supported request parameters and, where known, the Hugging Face id and knowledge cutoff. A per-model endpoints listing shows each upstream provider. The list endpoint needs no key; calling the models themselves does.

auth.notes: The model catalogue endpoints answered without a key; inference endpoints (chat/completions) need an OpenRouter API key.

rate_limit.summary: No limit documented or sent in headers for the catalogue endpoints.

endpoints.summary: All available models with pricing and capabilities
Upstream providers, prices and uptime for one model

license.name: OpenRouter Terms of Service; no data license stated

agent_notes: Prices are strings in USD per token (multiply by 1e6 for per-million). A price of "0" with a :free suffix on the id marks free-tier variants. The full list is one large response (466 models at check), so cache it. Use canonical_slug for a stable id across versions.
caveats: Only catalogue endpoints are keyless; actually calling a model needs a key.
The output_modalities filter returned a subset (68 models for image); the category parameter was not verified beyond returning HTTP 200.
Update cadence is an observation (new models appear within days), not documented.

verification.notes: Example executed without a key; 466 models returned.
